title: EvoDisco: Strategy Discovery for Evolving Agent Memory
abstract: arXiv:2611.22102v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model agents accumulate experience in memory, and how that memory evolves during interaction is as important as what it stores. Recent methods update memory online, yet both the operators that transform memory and the rules that select them remain fixed by design. We propose EvoDisco, which formulates agent memory evolution as evolutionary strategy discovery: the agent must discover which operator to apply, when to apply it, and how to instantiate it, rather than rewriting memory under a static operator schedule. A learnable policy conditions on the current memory state and recent task history, then selects and instantiates one of four semantic operators---Abstract, Refine, Bridge, and Reframe---which respectively compress related memories, decompose overloaded entries, connect weakly linked experiences, and reorganize retrieved reasoning chains. translated_title: EvoDisco：面向智能体记忆演化的策略发现
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体在记忆中积累经验，而记忆在交互过程中如何演化与其存储的内容同等重要。近期的记忆更新方法虽然可以在线更新记忆，但用于转换记忆的算子以及选择算子的规则在设计上都是固定的。我们提出EvoDisco，将智能体记忆演化形式化为演化式策略发现：智能体需要自主发现应用哪种算子、何时应用以及如何实例化该算子，而不是在静态的算子调度下重写记忆。一个可学习的策略以当前记忆状态和近期任务历史为条件，然后选择并实例化四种语义算子之一——摘要、精炼、桥接和重构——它们分别用于压缩相关记忆、分解过载条目、连接弱关联的经验以及重组检索到的推理链。该策略通过双层适应度机制进行更新。内部信号对每……
tldr: 该论文提出EvoDisco框架，将智能体记忆演化建模为演化式策略发现问题，由可学习策略根据记忆状态和任务历史动态选择并实例化四种语义算子，突破了传统记忆更新中算子与调度规则固定不变的限制。
en_tdlr: EvoDisco formulates agent memory evolution as evolutionary strategy discovery, where a learnable policy dynamically selects and instantiates among four semantic operators, breaking free from the fixed operator schedules of traditional memory updating methods.
